metadata.description: A curated marketplace of GitHub Copilot plugins aggregated from real-world customizations — agents, skills, and extensions packaged for team standardization and org-wide sharing.

plugins.name: jekyll-blog-writer
plugins.description: Story-first technical blog writer with Jekyll conventions and AI humanizer. Includes a blog writer agent, Jekyll specialist skill, and humanizer skill that work together to produce publish-ready posts.

plugins.name: sdlc-agents
plugins.description: Multi-agent SDLC workflow with orchestrator, planner, architect, developer, and tester agents that hand off work through the full software development lifecycle.

plugins.name: code-review-standards
plugins.description: Code review agents and standards for PR reviews, BigQuery SQL conventions, and data pipeline quality. Includes DevOps, QA, data analyst, and BPMN specialist agents.

plugins.name: terraform-landing-zone
plugins.description: Azure landing zone guardrails for Terraform. Skills for enforcing naming conventions, policy compliance, drift remediation, and brownfield resource import.

plugins.name: ssis-toolkit
plugins.description: SSIS package authoring and validation toolkit. Agents for authoring packages via metadata JSON (never hand-editing .dtsx) and a delivery-gate validator, plus skills for SQL conventions, SSISDB deployment, and metadata schemas.

plugins.name: presentation-builder
plugins.description: Build Reveal.js presentations with Copilot. Skills for slide authoring conventions and generating complete presentations from requirements.

plugins.name: databricks-dev
plugins.description: Databricks development expert agent with deep knowledge of the Databricks platform, VS Code integration, SQLTools, and best practices for notebooks, jobs, and Delta Lake.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Git workflow standardization skills — consistent commit messages, GitHub CLI operations, issue management, and contribution guidelines.

plugins.name: testing-toolkit
plugins.description: Testing skills for web application testing strategies, Playwright automation, Chrome DevTools browser automation, AI agent evaluation, and exploratory testing.

plugins.name: devops-azure
plugins.description: Azure DevOps and CI/CD skills — Azure Static Web Apps deployment, Azure DevOps CLI, App Insights instrumentation, Bicep deployment preflight validation, and Terraform AzureRM diff analysis.

plugins.name: mcp-development
plugins.description: Build Copilot extensions, MCP servers, and agentic workflows. Includes the agentic-workflows agent for creating AI-powered workflows and the Copilot SDK skill.

plugins.name: frontend-ui
plugins.description: Frontend and UI development skills for React, Vue, component design patterns, accessibility, and responsive design.
